# Documentation resources for nhanaz.io.vn

This scoped entry point collects the public documentation routes for the static archive. The documentation is read-only and does not describe an action service. The small page-view counter is documented separately in the OpenAPI document.

- [Agent instructions](https://nhanaz.io.vn/agent-instructions.md)
- [Short machine-readable index](https://nhanaz.io.vn/llms.txt)
- [Full machine-readable context](https://nhanaz.io.vn/llms-full.txt)
- [Developer resources](https://nhanaz.io.vn/developers/)
- [Developer resources in Markdown](https://nhanaz.io.vn/developers.md)
- [Canonical URL list](https://nhanaz.io.vn/sitemap.xml)
- [ARD catalog](https://nhanaz.io.vn/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
